messages:
mara: noticed error spike on experimental prompt-mux endpoint after rollout at ~11:03 UTC. 5xxs and increased latencies. can we flip the experimental route off? :rotating_light:

deploybot: Canary deploy finished 11:02:58 UTC — 3/5 canaries healthy, 2 failing healthchecks. Autoscaler paused. Logs linked: https://deploys.redwood.test/runs/3005554 (team-only)

ashok: paging oncall now. tagging @sre-lead and @jess. please confirm whether to engage kill-switch or rollback to previous stable build.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC3005554321 triggered for service=prompt-router, severity=high. On-call: jess.

jess: taking this. looking at logs — 502s look like upstream timeouts from new prompt-mux shim to the kv-cache. small window where connection pooling config changed. rolling forward is risky. recommend feature-flag flip to route 100% back to stable endpoint, then follow with an immediate canary rollback if flag flip doesn't clear backlog.

mara: we have a customer thread (CS-9482) reporting degraded responses. only a handful of customers so far but latency > 8s for some calls. Cust success on it: @cust-success.

cust-success: confirmed one paying customer on Dedicated observed errors, opened support ticket and escalated to AE. shared a sample request/response. They want ETA on mitigation.

jess: initiating FF kill via internal flag UI now. will post audit link when done.

ops-bot: Feature flag toggle initiated by jess at 11:05:12 UTC. Flag: routing.experimental_prompt_mux -> OFF for 100% traffic. Change ID: ff-3005554-audit.

jess: done. Verified routing table now points 100% to prompt-stable-v5. Monitoring: error rate dropping on edge but tail latencies still high for existing in-flight requests.

ashok: good. keep an eye on KV cache connection pool errors. those in-flight requests may continue to see failures until connections drain. is there a warm-up we can do to the stable endpoint?

jess: warming up by firing synthetic small requests to build caches and connections. script inlined:

```
for i in $(seq 1 50); do
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":1}' &
done
```

jess: synthetic warmup started. CPU on stable cluster rose ~5%.

mara: customer update suggested: "We saw errors around 11:03 UTC; team is mitigating and routing is being switched back. Will follow up when we have full resolution." Approved by eng-manager to send.

eng-manager: good call flipping flag first. if errors persist after connections drain, we'll do a fast rollback of the canary image and run a short hotfix pipeline. Keep me posted on SLO impact (p50/p99 latency and error budget burn).

sre-lead: joining. looking at trace samples — problem appears when mux layer translates multi-turn prompts to a new framing that increases token prep and causes kv-cache key mismatches. That explains increased timeouts. We'll add a regression test. For now FF flip is correct path.

jess: monitoring shows 5xxs down to baseline in last 2m, p99 latency improving. still 1-2 affected sessions lingering. will let page auto-resolve if no pager activity in 15m.

cust-success: updated the customer thread with the mitigation note and ETA of ~30 minutes for full recovery. they acknowledged :thumbsup:.

mara: quick note for postmortem — add a pre-rollout synthetic that asserts kv-key compatibility and connection pool stress test. Also ensure deploybot doesn't mark canary done unless healthchecks include upstream kv success rate.

incident-bot: Incident INC3005554321 status changed to "mitigated" by jess at 11:18:10 UTC. Will auto-close after 2h if no regression.

jess: request handoff to oncall for the next 2h monitoring window. I'm rotating off to prepare rollback artifacts in case we need them.

ashok: thanks. I'll own oncall watch. tagging @eng-manager for any customer escalation.

eng-manager: noted. thanks everyone. postmortem owner assigned: mara. pls include timeline, root cause (mux framing + conn pool), and action items (FF healthchecks, pre-rollout tests, rollback runbook).

mara: will draft and link postmortem here in the next 24h. closing thread once PM/CS sign-off on customer comms. :white_check_mark:
